text: Binary per-row measure from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parse it): returns 1 if the list is non-empty and every substantive comment relies solely on abstract logic/reasoning (general principles, definitions, conceptual or logical argument) with no concrete real-world example (specific actual case, event, person, institution or personal experience). Returns 0 if at least one comment contains a concrete real-world example, or any substantive comment relies on something other than abstract logic alone. Ignores OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, text reporting whether the outcome occurred, and moderator/bot notices; generic delta/platform rule discussion is not an announcement but also not a concrete example. List order is irrelevant. Returns null if the list is empty, missing or malformed.
